title: find request
description: The params object of the `find` tool. Exact finding: words, a phrase (quoted) or a prefix (trailing *). Principal labels are never a caller field: the host supplies the scope (docs/tool-schemas.md).

query.description: A query in double quotes is a phrase; a trailing * makes the last word a prefix.

mode.description: Matching mode; a quoted query forces phrase and a trailing * forces prefix.

roots.description: Root ids to search. Narrows the server's roots, never widens them; absent or null means every root the server allows.

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor ("<generation>:<offset>"). A cursor from another generation is refused as a stale cursor.
